en.name: CodeDeal
en.subtitle: Promo codes that work
en.description:
CodeDeal collects discount codes and gets out of the way.

FIND ONE
Browse by category or search — including by voice — and filter to what you are actually shopping for. Every deal shows the code, the store, and what it takes off.

USE IT
One tap copies the code, another opens the store. Share a deal with whoever needs it.

KEEP UP
Follow the categories you buy in and get told when something lands.

YOURS
Sign in to sync your profile, or do not — browsing needs no account.
